thought.text: The login form has `login`, `password`, `state` fields. Let me complete the login and follow to the callback.

reasoning_content: The login form has fields for `login`, `password`, and `state`. Now let me POST the credentials and follow the redirects to get back to the Matrix callback, and then use the loginToken.

action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-validate
ST=$(grep -o 'name="state" value="[^"]*"' dex_auth_full.html | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
echo "state=$ST"
echo "=== POST login ==="
curl -sSL -m 15 -b dex_cookies.txt -c dex_cookies.txt --data-urlencode "login=kai@example.com" --data-urlencode "password=changeme" --data-urlencode "state=$ST" -o post.html -w 'final_url:%{url_effective}\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n' "http://dex:5556/dex/auth/local/login?back=&state=$ST"
echo "=== post body ==="
head -c 400 post.html; echo
